meta.title: 告别罚站式拍照 站、坐、俯、仰花里胡哨出片！
meta.title_en: Ditch the Stiff-Standing Photo — Sit, Squat, Angle, Shoot!
meta.topic: 拍照教学 · 告别罚站

scenes.title_cn: 铁律：脑袋放九宫格第一条线
scenes.title_en: The Iron Rule: Head on the First Grid Line
scenes.context: 拍到这条视频就告别罚站式拍照。首先有一条铁律：不管你是正拍、仰拍、俯拍、自拍，打开手机的九宫格，你的脑袋主体永远只能在第一条线靠下一点的位置区间，眼睛不要出现在第一条线靠上。语域：拍照教学，铁律输出。
sentences: 拍到这条视频，就告别罚站式拍照。
Catch this video and ditch the stiff-standing photo.
stiff-standing（罚站式）
不管正拍、仰拍、俯拍、自拍，打开九宫格。
Front, low, top, or selfie — always open the grid.
open the grid（打开九宫格）
脑袋永远在第一条线靠下的区间。
Your head stays in the area just below the first line.
just below the first line（第一条线靠下）
paraphrase: 罚站式 → stiff-standing / frozen soldier pose
九宫格 → the grid / nine-square grid
scenes.speak: Catch this video and ditch the stiff-standing photo. Front, low, top, or selfie — always open the grid. Your head stays in the area just below the first line.

scenes.title_cn: 构图：拍哪就让哪接近底线
scenes.title_en: Composition: Bring What You Shoot Near the Bottom Line
scenes.context: 构图：拍哪就让哪（膝盖/脚）无限接近九宫格最下面的线。俯拍：往后仰躺、下巴平行不低头、胳膊撑起，头肩比和谐。语域：拍照教学，构图讲解。
sentences: 拍哪就让哪，接近九宫格最下面的线。
Whatever you shoot — knee or foot — bring it near the bottom line.
the bottom line（最下面的线）
俯拍：往后仰躺，下巴平行不低头。
Top-down: lean back, keep the chin level, don't drop it.
keep the chin level（下巴平行）
胳膊撑起，头肩比和谐。
Prop on your arms for a balanced head-to-shoulder ratio.
head-to-shoulder ratio（头肩比）
paraphrase: 接近底线 → near the bottom line / hug the bottom
scenes.speak: Whatever you shoot — knee or foot — bring it near the bottom line. Top-down: lean back, keep the chin level, don't drop it. Prop on your arms for a balanced head-to-shoulder ratio.

scenes.context: 仰拍：手机拿低，身体前倾往前勾，互动感强。自拍：手里要有东西（叉子/咖啡/甜品）作镜头主体，有生活感。语域：拍照教学，姿势讲解。
sentences: 仰拍：手机拿低，身体前倾往前勾。
Low angle: hold the phone low and lean your body toward it.
lean toward（前倾）
互动感强，画面更生动。
Strong interaction makes the frame livelier.
strong interaction（互动感强）
自拍：手里要有东西，作镜头主体。
Selfie: keep something in hand as the lens subject.
lens subject（镜头主体）
paraphrase: 低机位 → low angle / hold the phone low
镜头主体 → lens subject / foreground object
scenes.speak: Low angle: hold the phone low and lean your body toward it. Strong interaction makes the frame livelier. Selfie: keep something in hand as the lens subject.

scenes.title_en: Seated Shot: Feet in the 45° Range
scenes.context: 坐拍：脚在前后45度区间——不伸太直（腿短）也不折太回（没脚）。掌握这个区间，坐着拍也出片。语域：拍照教学，收尾。
sentences: 坐拍：脚在前后45度区间。
Seated shot: keep your feet within a 45° front-back range.
a 45° range（45度区间）
不伸太直，腿会显得短。
Don't stretch them too straight or the legs look short.
legs look short（显腿短）
也不折太回，脚就没了。
Don't tuck them too far or your feet disappear.
feet disappear（脚就没了）
paraphrase: 折太回 → tuck too far / fold back too much
scenes.speak: Seated shot: keep your feet within a 45° front-back range. Don't stretch them too straight or the legs look short. Don't tuck them too far or your feet disappear.

practice: Open the grid and keep your head just below the first line.
Lean back, keep the chin level, and bring what you shoot near the bottom line.
Hold the phone low and keep something in hand as the subject.
Keep your feet within a 45° range when seated.
pitfalls: 「九宫格」用 the grid / nine-square grid，不是 palace。
The head is on the first line.
Keep your head just below the first line.
「第一条线靠下」用 just below the first line。
Keep your feet within a 45° front-back range.
shifts: 用 stiff-standing（罚站式）、ditch（告别）、open the grid（打开九宫格）
用 bottom line（底线）、chin level（下巴平行）、head-to-shoulder ratio（头肩比）
用 low angle（仰拍）、top-down（俯拍）、lean toward（前倾）、45° range（45度区间）
